claim: Northstar Pay launched instant bank transfers on 1 August 2025.

articles.title: Northstar Pay introduces instant bank transfers
articles.content: Northstar Pay announced that instant bank transfers became available to customers on 1 August 2025. The feature allows users to transfer funds between supported bank accounts within seconds.

claim: The Kestrel EV battery warranty lasts eight years.

articles.title: Kestrel announces warranty details for its electric vehicle
articles.content: Kestrel Motors confirmed that the high-voltage battery fitted to the Kestrel EV is covered by an eight-year manufacturer warranty, subject to the stated mileage limit.

claim: HarborCity Transit added twelve electric buses to its fleet in 2024.

articles.title: HarborCity Transit expands its electric bus fleet
articles.content: HarborCity Transit added twelve battery-powered electric buses to its public transport fleet during 2024. The vehicles will operate on routes serving the eastern districts.

claim: BluePeak launched its cloud backup service on 15 January 2026.

articles.title: BluePeak launches a new cloud backup platform
articles.content: BluePeak Technologies launched its cloud backup service on 15 January 2026. The service provides automated backups for business customers.

claim: Silverline Foods opened three cold-storage facilities in Tamil Nadu in 2025.

articles.title: Silverline Foods expands its cold-chain network
articles.content: Silverline Foods confirmed that it opened three new cold-storage facilities in Tamil Nadu during 2025. The facilities support the company's regional distribution operations.

claim: The NovaTech X5 smartphone has a 120Hz display.

articles.title: NovaTech X5 specifications confirmed
articles.content: The NovaTech X5 features a 6.5-inch display with a refresh rate of 120Hz. The company confirmed the display specification in its official product announcement.

claim: Orion Motors opened its first electric vehicle assembly plant in Jaipur in 2025.

articles.title: Orion Motors confirms no new assembly plant opened in 2025
articles.content: Orion Motors confirmed that it did not open an electric vehicle assembly plant in Jaipur during 2025. Vehicle production continued at its existing facility in Chennai.

claim: LumaPay offers international money transfers without any transaction fees.

articles.title: LumaPay publishes its international transfer fee schedule
articles.content: LumaPay's international transfer service charges customers a transaction fee of 2 percent of the transferred amount. The fee applies to all standard international transfers.

claim: The Aster Phone 12 supports 5G connectivity.

articles.title: Aster Phone 12 connectivity specifications
articles.content: The Aster Phone 12 does not support 5G connectivity. Its modem supports 4G LTE networks only.

claim: RiverRail launched its Pune to Nashik passenger service on 1 June 2025.

articles.title: RiverRail postpones its Pune-Nashik passenger service
articles.content: RiverRail confirmed that its planned Pune-Nashik passenger service did not begin on 1 June 2025. The launch was postponed because infrastructure testing remained incomplete.

claim: GreenBasket currently operates fifty retail stores in Kerala.

articles.title: GreenBasket publishes its current store count
articles.content: GreenBasket currently operates thirty-two retail stores across Kerala. The company has not yet reached its previously announced target of fifty stores.

claim: CloudDesk discontinued all paid subscription plans in 2025.

articles.title: CloudDesk confirms its paid subscription plans remain active
articles.content: CloudDesk confirmed that it did not discontinue its paid subscription plans in 2025. Customers continue to renew their subscriptions under the existing pricing structure.

claim: Northstar Pay offers international money transfers without transaction fees.

articles.title: Northstar Pay introduces a redesigned mobile application
articles.content: Northstar Pay released a redesigned mobile application featuring a new interface, updated navigation, and an improved transaction history screen.

claim: The Kestrel EV battery warranty lasts eight years.

articles.title: Kestrel EV driving range announced
articles.content: Kestrel Motors announced that its electric vehicle offers a certified driving range of 450 kilometres on a full charge. The figure was measured under the company's stated test conditions.

claim: HarborCity Transit added twelve electric buses to its fleet in 2025.

articles.title: HarborCity Transit expands its fleet during 2024
articles.content: HarborCity Transit added twelve electric buses to its fleet during 2024. The buses were introduced to improve public transport capacity in the eastern districts.

claim: BluePeak launched its cloud backup service in India in January 2026.

articles.title: BluePeak opens a new data centre in Singapore
articles.content: BluePeak Technologies opened a new data centre in Singapore to expand its regional infrastructure. The announcement describes the facility and its expected capacity.

claim: Silverline Foods operates the largest cold-storage network in Tamil Nadu.

articles.title: Silverline Foods expands its cold-storage network
articles.content: Silverline Foods opened three cold-storage facilities in Tamil Nadu during 2025. The new facilities increase the company's regional storage capacity.

claim: The NovaTech X5 has the best camera in its price category.

articles.title: Customers share their first impressions of the NovaTech X5
articles.content: Several customers praised the NovaTech X5 for its smooth interface, comfortable design, and battery life. The reviews did not include controlled camera comparisons against competing smartphones.

claim: MetroLink began operating its Blue Line extension on 1 April 2025.

articles.title: MetroLink begins Blue Line extension operations
articles.content: MetroLink confirmed that passenger operations on its Blue Line extension began on 1 April 2025. The extension adds four stations to the existing network.

claim: Astra Foods opened its Pune distribution centre in November 2025.

articles.title: Astra Foods opens new distribution centre in Pune
articles.content: Astra Foods announced that its new distribution centre in Pune officially opened on 18 November 2025. The facility will serve customers across western India.

claim: CedarTel launched its 5G home internet service on 10 May 2025.

articles.title: CedarTel postpones its 5G home internet launch
articles.content: CedarTel confirmed that its 5G home internet service did not launch on 10 May 2025. The company postponed the launch until 1 June 2025 because network testing was incomplete.

claim: Lumen Bikes did not release an electric scooter in 2025.

articles.title: Lumen Bikes releases its first electric scooter
articles.content: Lumen Bikes released its first electric scooter in December 2025. The company confirmed that customer deliveries began during the same month.

claim: MetroLink added five Blue Line stations in 2025.

articles.title: MetroLink opens three new Blue Line stations
articles.content: MetroLink opened three new Blue Line stations in August 2024. The stations expanded service to the northern districts. The announcement does not discuss station additions during 2025.

claim: Astra Foods opened a distribution centre in Chennai in 2025.

articles.title: Astra Foods opens distribution centre in Pune
articles.content: Astra Foods opened a distribution centre in Pune in November 2024. The facility serves customers across western India. The announcement does not mention a Chennai facility or any opening during 2025.
